messages:
Oncall Bot: [ALERT] reserved-gpu-east-2 pool at 98% GPU allocation, queue length increasing > 400. Auto-scale attempts failing (rate-limited). Paging oncall.
Alex: i'm awake, looking.
Nina: i'm on infra. grabbing metrics + recent autoscaler logs.
Arjun: seeing spikes in tenant qps from tenant:novahealth-prod, also heavy batch jobs from tenant:acme-analytics.
Lia: customer impact? any 429s or slow responses reported?
Jordan (CustSRE): Jordan here — NovaHealth reporting 5-10s tail latency and occasional 429s for realtime endpoints. They just opened a support ticket.
Alex: thanks jordan. adding them to incident notes.
Nina: autoscaler logs: "RateLimitExceeded: scale_request_rejected" repeated. Cloud quota hitting concurrent instance limit for region. Posting snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:03Z autoscaler INFO request_scale target=reserved-gpu-east-2 desired=12 current=8 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T02:14:04Z cloud_api ERROR QuotaExceeded: GPU quota exceeded for project=redwood-prod region=us-east-2
2026-03-15T02:15:10Z autoscaler WARN RateLimitExceeded: retrying in backoff
```
Arjun: that matches. reserved pool size pinned by enterprise contracts; we can't just steal those GPUs without risking tenant isolation.
OpsBot: suggested mitigation: temporary routing of best-effort traffic to hosted fallback-models; requires service-owners approval.
Alex: can we evict noisy batch jobs in reserved pool (acme-analytics) to free capacity for realtime tenants?
Nina: we can evict non-reserved jobs, but need tenant eviction policy run. Running command now:
`./tools/evict_tenant_jobs --pool reserved-gpu-east-2 --tenant acme-analytics --dry-run=false`
Nina: eviction started, evicting 18 pods. ETA ~45s.
Arjun: also opening immediate fallback route: any requests hitting throttled reserved endpoints will route to hosted-inference with lower concurrency for non-SLA tenants. Config:
```
route_policy: if tenant.sla != enterprise and pool.util > 95% -> route: hosted-fallback
```
Lia: should we notify the enterprise customers before eviction? Might break their long-running analytics.
Ryan (PM): priority is realtime customers (NovaHealth). Notify Acme SRE and queue a compensation discussion. Document in incident.
Jordan (CustSRE): NovaHealth: please do whatever to restore realtime throughput. They are in triage.
Alex: evictions completed. freed 4 GPUs; pool util now 92%. queue length dropping from 420 -> 180.
Oncall Bot: [EVENT] fallback routing enabled for non-enterprise tenants at 02:21 UTC.
Nina: autoscaler still hitting cloud quota. raising support ticket with cloud provider for quota bump — ticket #CLOUD-8421.
Arjun: action items: 1) confirm Acme job resubmit strategy, 2) request emergency quota increase, 3) run post-incident analysis on noisy neighbor detection.
OpsBot: created incident ticket RED-INC-2026-0315 and linked customer tickets: NOVA-454, ACME-988.
Lia: initial customer impact summary: NovaHealth experienced elevated tail latencies and intermittent 429s for 12 minutes. Acme analytics jobs preempted (evicted) — they lost progress on 3 jobs (not realtime); will need retry.
Ryan (PM): comms: send high-priority status update to affected customers, include ETA for quota resolution and mitigation steps taken.
Alex: handing off to night oncall (Nina) for watch-and-wait. escalation to infra-engineering if fallback routing exceeds 30% of requests.
Nina: will monitor dashboards, set alert for queue > 200 or fallback_ratio > 0.3. logging handoff in pager duty.
Eng-SRE: please run a quick eval of autoscaler backoff logic tomorrow; looks like rate-limit/backoff interplay prevented progressive scaling.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Recording timeline and action items.
Alex: summarizing: root cause = simultaneous heavy batch + realtime load in same reserved pool + cloud quota preventing autoscale; mitigation = evict best-effort tenants, enable hosted fallback routing, request quota bump. Postmortem required.
Ryan (PM): assigning postmortem to Eng-SRE + Product. Add quant metrics: minutes to mitigation, customers impacted, GPUs freed, fallback traffic percent.
Jordan (CustSRE): thanks team. I will update NovaHealth and confirm they see normal traffic now.
Nina: last check: pool util 87%, queue 72. closing active mitigation but keeping alerting on. will follow up in incident ticket.
Alex: thanks all, good work. closing thread and will attach logs to RED-INC-2026-0315.
